name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted gym and body-weight tracker to plan routines, log workouts and see which muscles are trained, with passkey sign-in.

alerts.message: The first profile created on the instance becomes its admin, and signup stays open: register your own profile before sharing the address, then set INVITE_ONLY=1 if needed.
Passkeys only work over HTTPS and are bound to the domain in RP_ID and ORIGIN. Deploy on the final domain: changing it later invalidates every existing passkey.
